title: HTML and JavaScript Integration
description: Learn how to integrate JavaScript with HTML to create dynamic and interactive web pages.

quiz.question: Which HTML tag is used to include JavaScript code in a webpage?
quiz.explanation: The `<script>` tag is used to embed or reference JavaScript code.

quiz.question: How do you include an external JavaScript file in HTML?
quiz.explanation: The `src` attribute inside the `<script>` tag specifies the external JavaScript file.

quiz.question: Where is the best place to put the `<script>` tag to ensure the HTML content loads first?
options: At the end of the `<body>` tag
quiz.correctAnswer: At the end of the `<body>` tag
quiz.explanation: Placing scripts at the end of the body ensures the DOM is loaded before JavaScript runs.

quiz.question: What does the `defer` attribute do when added to a `<script>` tag?
options: Delays script execution until the HTML is fully parsed
quiz.correctAnswer: Delays script execution until the HTML is fully parsed
quiz.explanation: `defer` loads the script asynchronously and executes it after parsing is complete.

quiz.question: How can JavaScript access and modify HTML elements?
options: By embedding JavaScript directly in HTML attributes
quiz.explanation: JavaScript uses DOM APIs to manipulate HTML elements dynamically.

quiz.question: Which event listener method is commonly used to handle user interactions in JavaScript?
quiz.explanation: It attaches an event handler to an element without overwriting existing events.

quiz.question:
What is the result of this code snippet?
`document.getElementById('demo').innerHTML = 'Hello!';`
options: Sets the text inside the element with id 'demo' to 'Hello!'
Creates a new element with the text 'Hello!'
quiz.correctAnswer: Sets the text inside the element with id 'demo' to 'Hello!'
quiz.explanation: The `innerHTML` property modifies the HTML content inside the targeted element.

quiz.question: How can you run JavaScript code after the page content is fully loaded?
quiz.explanation: `DOMContentLoaded` and `window.onload` are common ways to run JS after loading.

quiz.question: What attribute allows inline JavaScript execution on HTML elements (e.g., on a button click)?
quiz.explanation: The `onclick` attribute allows JavaScript code to run when the element is clicked.

quiz.question: How do you comment out JavaScript code?
quiz.explanation: JavaScript uses `//` for single-line and `/* */` for multi-line comments.
